notes.title: Rabbit's Tale - Dev Update #02
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Let’s start with something small for this 2nd dev update.

Let’s start with befores and afters, they are always interesting to watch as time passes by and as we plan, build, improve and iterate through it.

The first one is on Moss Caves:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42078059/2340907b1400eebfe88584665ec871dcf88555ca.gif

This one is a great example of the iterative process that goes into development.

In addition to the absolute visual difference, which for us is so mesmerizing to watch, there’s an interesting outcome of this iteration: make it harder!

On the before part, when we even had a pink rabbit and the scene was only blocks, we only had two enemies shooting at us while we were taking the elevator up.

Through internal testing, we eventually realized it was a bit too easy (considering the section of the game - a couple of hours in) and we decided to bump the difficulty a bit and add a third enemy so players can practice the skills they have been sharpening. 

It also was reported that it was hard and frustrating to get out of the elevator at the top because, sometimes we would hit the platform above. So, we opened the “ceiling” and made the drop off easier. 

We also added sections that can only be accessed later on by unlocking other abilities. Which is a must in a metroidvania and makes you think about level design in a much deeper way.

So yeah, even though it’s a small portion of the game, there’s a considerable amount of iteration that went through, and we thought it could be interesting to share with you.

[hr] [/hr]
Here’s another before and after worth sharing with you, a simpler one but with an important lesson: keep it simple!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42078059/5c47f46b37baa3f0b8975af04174b07a3c417b56.gif

In this section here, while testing, we noticed many people didn’t get the jump at the first try.

It was too hard to start with. 

Eventually leading to some players feeling a bit moody at the start, which is not ideal when beginning a game.

So, we eventually shortened the gap and made the jump easier, to smooth the player experience. 

But all in all, the visuals are what takes a big chunk of our time. Just take a minute to appreciate all the details that go in! 

Let's be honest, that’s why we made this dev update, just to share the fantastic evolution with you guys. And perhaps share some game dev insights along the way. ;) 

[hr] [/hr]
And to conclude this dev update on iteration - on befores and afters - the last content we wanna share with you brings one of the oldest lessons to the table: sketch it first! (even if it is a quick sketchy mess that you and the illustrator have to decipher)

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42078059/3b2b8556e84b2272ae212e8b0833760025124ea3.gif

Sketching is probably one of the most essential parts of game development in more areas. 

Getting your ideas on paper helps you think and visualize them with more clarity. Plus you can share it with other people and get their opinion rather quickly. 

Sometimes the end product comes out different from the sketch, but that’s good. That’s the iterative process of trial and error working its way. 

Or sometimes it comes out exactly as you sketched it, like the one above. (If the illustrator is able to decipher it)

[hr] [/hr]
If you liked this update then consider adding Rabbit's Tale to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1763860/Rabbits_Tale/

Until then, follow us on socials for more regular updates: Twitter | TikTok | Facebook | Instagram

notes.title: Rabbit's Tale - Dev Update #01
notes.content:
Hi folks! We are Golden Bug, and we bring you Rabbit’s Tale!

It started with 2 members 3 years ago with lots of “on” and “off” moments, but eventually we started developing the game full-time and, in the past year, we expanded the team to 4 members!

There’s so much to tell and show, but “recently” we have been focusing on creating the levels for the game and testing the game mechanics, with enemies, traps, interactables and so much more. 

In the meantime, since we have already defined the world of Rabbit’s Tale, its ecosystems and different areas, we also moved on to create the art, the visuals, the mood and atmosphere.

And we are going to show a sneak peak of that today!

[hr] [/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42078059/ce91d5d5a2a61cd26acd5e0737ecc5fdd6675d3d.jpg

CARROT’S VILLAGE

Carrot’s Village - where our tale starts, a place of peace and harmony. The center of the rabbit’s homeland. You can almost feel the sun, a fine breeze and hear the birds. Hopefully it can stay like this forever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42078059/444ffa1b70527f623633b37021cfdf1991c9ebfa.jpg

Its inhabitants, the rabbits, have all sorts of housing preferences - some live in burrows underneath the ground, while some live in more traditional surface cottages. The more adventurous even like to build their homes on trees!

[hr] [/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42078059/0547f0517778845634c1402328299024003da7f8.jpg

MOSS CAVES

The Moss Caves are both a place of “Awww” and “Argghhh”. Both a mesmerizing place and a place where the difficulty is bumped. A place  full of moist, mossy rocks and you can hear dripping water echoing in the distance and other strange, cryptic sounds, as you explore its depths and most hidden secrets. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42078059/bdf51007e4a60f83279071471f65b72d52445d68.jpg

There are also spots close to the surface where the light passes through holes on the cave's ceiling and bounces off the rocks reflecting beautiful god rays. Perhaps a rainbow is visible. And below, nature developed fascinating luminous plants of amazing blue, purple and yellow tones. So beautiful, yet so dangerous!

[hr] [/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42078059/44d2cad9c3b0d4bf045dab2438be510d2e95d14d.jpg

DEEP WOODS

Deep Woods is where it seems like it’s autumn and spring at the same time, bringing fresh air amidst big, towering trees. So big, that I’ve heard there are even lifeforms inside them and perhaps you can walk there too.The idea here is to have a great, dense forest with lots of trees and a mysterious feeling swirling in the air

Some say in the depths of the Deep Woods there is also a mystical dark energy emanating, luring the more adventurous - but only tales have been told, none ever saw it.

[hr] [/hr]
Which area are you most excited for? Let us know in the comments below!

There’s so much more we wanna share and show, and that we will show! Follow our Socials for new updates and sneak peaks of pretty much anything we are doing!

We also have great news as well - there will soon be a new trailer with the new Rabbit. We are aiming to release it in February or March! 

We will post more often here, thanks for reading! :)

If you liked this update then consider adding Rabbit's Tale to your wishlist!

Follow for more on: Twitter | TikTok | Facebook | Instagram
